newsitem.title: USA: NASDAQ SHARES RATTLED BY INTEREST RATES, EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: NASDAQ SHARES RATTLED BY INTEREST RATES, EARNINGS.

text.p: Nasdaq shares dropped sharply Friday, echoing losses in the broader market, after a rapid rise in interest rates rattled investors, traders said.

The Nasdaq composite index fell for the second day, losing 25.66 points or 1.58 percent to close unofficially at 1598.52. Declining issues beat gainers almost two-to-one on heavy volume of 702 million shares.

"With the bond market off and the Dow down almost two percent, the Nasdaq really had nothing to do but go down. It didn't suffer as much as the Dow, since techs have pretty strong lately, but today most of the major names dropped," one trader said.
The Dow industrials shed 157 points to 8031, while the benchmark 30-year Treasury bond lost one and a half points to yield 6.64 percent.
Earnings warnings and weak quarterly results from several companies also compounded Nasdaq's weakness, traders said.

Informix Corp lost 1-3/16 to 9-1/8 after posting a second quarter loss and saying it will restate its 1996 results. PetsMart Inc , the second most-active Nasdaq issue, lost 24 percent after it said after Thursday's close it expects its second quarter results to fall below Wall Street expectations.
